title: Rare copies
statementMd:
Find books of which the library owns exactly one copy.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title FROM books WHERE copies = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
